title: "Modernization Workbook"

          <style>
            :root {

              --mw-teal:    #1E8C8C;
              --mw-teal-lt: #27BEBE;

              --mw-amber:   #B27210;

            }

            body #title-block-header { display: none !important; }

            /* Full-bleed page */
            body main.content,

            body div.page-columns {
              padding-left: 0 !important;
              padding-right: 0 !important;
              max-width: none !important;
            }

            .mw-landing {
              font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif;

            }
            .mw-landing a { color: var(--mw-teal); }

            /* Hero */
            .mw-landing .mw-hero {

              background:
                radial-gradient(900px 380px at 80% 0%, rgba(30,140,140,0.12), transparent 70%),
                radial-gradient(700px 280px at 0% 30%, rgba(232,160,32,0.10), transparent 70%),

            }
            .mw-landing .hero-eyebrow {

            }

            }
            .mw-landing .mw-hero h1 em { font-style: italic; color: var(--mw-teal); }
            .mw-landing .hero-sub { font-size: 1.15rem; color: var(--mw-muted); max-width: 60ch; margin: 0 auto 2.5rem; }
            .mw-landing .hero-actions { display: flex; gap: 1rem; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
            .mw-landing .btn-primary,
            .mw-landing .btn-ghost {
              font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: .82rem; letter-spacing: .08em;
              padding: .85rem 1.8rem; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase;
              font-weight: 500; border-radius: 4px; display: inline-block;
              transition: background .2s, transform .15s, box-shadow .2s, border-color .2s, color .2s;
            }
            .mw-landing .btn-primary { background: var(--mw-teal); color: white !important; border: 1px solid var(--mw-teal); }
            .mw-landing .btn-primary:hover {
              background: var(--mw-teal-lt); border-color: var(--mw-teal-lt); transform: translateY(-2px);
              box-shadow: 0 10px 22px -10px rgba(30,140,140,0.5);
            }
            .mw-landing .btn-ghost { border: 1px solid var(--mw-steel); color: var(--mw-navy) !important; background: white; }
            .mw-landing .btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--mw-teal); color: var(--mw-teal) !important; transform: translateY(-2px); }

            /* Marquee */
            .mw-landing .marquee-wrap {
              overflow: hidden; border-top: 1px solid var(--mw-line); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--mw-line);
              padding: .9rem 0; background: var(--mw-paper-2);
            }
            .mw-landing .marquee-track { display: flex; gap: 3rem; white-space: nowrap; animation: mwMarquee 34s linear infinite; }
            .mw-landing .marquee-item {
              font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: .72rem; letter-spacing: .15em;
              color: var(--mw-muted); text-transform: uppercase; flex-shrink: 0;
            }
            .mw-landing .marquee-item span { color: var(--mw-teal); margin-right: .6rem; }
            .mw-landing .marquee-track:hover { animation-play-state: paused; }

            /* Sections */
            .mw-landing .mw-section { padding: 5rem 3rem; }
            .mw-landing .mw-inner { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; }
            .mw-landing .section-label {
              font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: .72rem; letter-spacing: .2em;
              color: var(--mw-amber); text-transform: uppercase; margin-bottom: .8rem; font-weight: 500;
            }
            .mw-landing .section-title {
              font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif; font-weight: 400;
              font-size: clamp(1.8rem, 3.4vw, 2.6rem); line-height: 1.18;
              color: var(--mw-navy); max-width: 26ch; margin: 0 0 1.25rem; border: 0;
            }
            .mw-landing .section-body { color: var(--mw-muted); max-width: 64ch; font-size: 1rem; }
            .mw-landing .band {
              background: var(--mw-paper-2);
              border-top: 1px solid var(--mw-line); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--mw-line);
            }

            /* Why / What / Who / How pillars */
            .mw-landing .pillars { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 1.5rem; margin-top: 2.5rem; }
            @media (max-width: 1200px) { .mw-landing .pillars { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }
            .mw-landing .pillar {
              background: white; border: 1px solid var(--mw-line); border-top: 3px solid var(--mw-red);
              border-radius: 6px; padding: 2rem 1.6rem;
              transition: transform .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease;
            }
            .mw-landing .pillar.what { border-top-color: var(--mw-navy); }
            .mw-landing .pillar.who  { border-top-color: var(--mw-teal); }
            .mw-landing .pillar.how  { border-top-color: var(--mw-amber-lt); }
            .mw-landing .pillar:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -18px rgba(13,27,46,0.18); }
            .mw-landing .pillar-label {
              font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: .7rem; letter-spacing: .18em;
              color: var(--mw-red); text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 500;
            }
            .mw-landing .pillar.what .pillar-label { color: var(--mw-navy); }
            .mw-landing .pillar.who  .pillar-label { color: var(--mw-teal); }
            .mw-landing .pillar.how  .pillar-label { color: var(--mw-amber); }
            .mw-landing .pillar h3 {
              font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif; font-weight: 400; color: var(--mw-navy);
              font-size: 1.5rem; margin: .6rem 0 .8rem; line-height: 1.2; border: 0;
            }
            .mw-landing .pillar p { color: var(--mw-muted); font-size: .95rem; margin: 0; }

            /* Problem */
            .mw-landing .problem-grid {
              display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 4rem; align-items: start;
            }
            .mw-landing .problem-list { list-style: none; margin: 1.5rem 0 0; padding: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; }
            .mw-landing .problem-list li { display: flex; gap: 1rem; align-items: flex-start; color: var(--mw-ink); font-size: .98rem; }
            .mw-landing .problem-list li::before {
              content: '//'; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; color: var(--mw-teal);
              flex-shrink: 0; margin-top: .1rem; font-weight: 500;
            }
            .mw-landing .problem-list a { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: .78rem; letter-spacing: .06em; white-space: nowrap; }

            /* Book cards */
            .mw-landing .book-cards {
              display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(270px, 1fr));
              gap: 1.25rem; margin: 2.5rem 0 0;
            }
            .mw-landing .book-card {
              background: white; border: 1px solid var(--mw-line); border-radius: 6px;
              padding: 1.6rem 1.4rem 1.3rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column;
              transition: transform .15s, box-shadow .15s, border-color .15s;
            }
            .mw-landing .book-card:hover {
              transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 14px 30px -18px rgba(13,27,46,0.18); border-color: var(--mw-teal);
            }
            .mw-landing .book-num {
              font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: .68rem; letter-spacing: .18em;
              text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--mw-amber); margin-bottom: .5rem; font-weight: 500;
            }
            .mw-landing .book-title {
              font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 1.3rem;
              color: var(--mw-navy); margin-bottom: .4rem; line-height: 1.25;
            }
            .mw-landing .book-title a { color: var(--mw-navy); text-decoration: none; }
            .mw-landing .book-title a:hover { color: var(--mw-teal); }
            .mw-landing .book-q { font-style: italic; color: var(--mw-ink); font-size: .95rem; margin-bottom: .5rem; }
            .mw-landing .book-desc { font-size: .85rem; color: var(--mw-muted); line-height: 1.5; margin-bottom: 1rem; }
            .mw-landing .book-links { margin-top: auto; display: flex; gap: 1.1rem; flex-wrap: wrap; }
            .mw-landing .book-links a {
              font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: .72rem; letter-spacing: .12em;
              color: var(--mw-teal); text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500;
            }
            .mw-landing .book-links a:hover { color: var(--mw-teal-lt); }

            /* Numbers */
            .mw-landing .arc-grid {
              display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(170px, 1fr));
              gap: 1px; background: var(--mw-line); border: 1px solid var(--mw-line);
              border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; margin: 2rem 0 0;
            }
            .mw-landing .arc-phase { background: white; padding: 1.5rem 1.2rem; text-align: center; transition: background .2s; }
            .mw-landing .arc-phase:hover { background: var(--mw-teal-bg); }
            .mw-landing .phase-num { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 1.6rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--mw-teal); margin-bottom: .4rem; }
            .mw-landing .phase-name { font-family: 'DM Serif Display', serif; font-size: 1.05rem; color: var(--mw-navy); margin-bottom: .4rem; line-height: 1.25; }
            .mw-landing .phase-desc { font-size: .82rem; color: var(--mw-muted); line-height: 1.45; }

            /* Planned books */
            .mw-landing .badge-grid { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: .75rem; margin-top: 1.5rem; }
            .mw-landing .badge {
              font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: .74rem; letter-spacing: .1em;
              padding: .6rem 1.1rem; border: 1px solid var(--mw-line); color: var(--mw-navy);
              text-transform: uppercase; background: white; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 500;
            }
            .mw-landing .badge b { color: var(--mw-teal); font-weight: 500; margin-right: .5rem; }

            /* CTA */
            .mw-landing .cta-band {
              background:
                radial-gradient(700px 280px at 100% 0%, rgba(30,140,140,0.18), transparent 70%),
                radial-gradient(500px 220px at 0% 100%, rgba(232,160,32,0.14), transparent 70%),
                var(--mw-paper-2);
              border-top: 1px solid var(--mw-line); text-align: center;
            }
            .mw-landing .cta-band .section-title,
            .mw-landing .cta-band .section-body { margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto; }
            .mw-landing .cta-band .section-body { margin-bottom: 2rem; }

            @keyframes mwMarquee { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-50%); } }

            @media (max-width: 900px) {
              .mw-landing .pillars { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
              .mw-landing .problem-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 2rem; }
            }
            @media (max-width: 640px) {
              .mw-landing .mw-section { padding: 3.5rem 1rem; }
              .mw-landing .mw-hero { padding: 3.5rem 1rem 3rem; }
            }

            .mw-landing section[id] { scroll-margin-top: 84px; }
            .mw-landing a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--mw-teal); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 4px; }
            @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
              .mw-landing .marquee-track { animation: none; }
              .mw-landing .btn-primary, .mw-landing .btn-ghost, .mw-landing .pillar,
              .mw-landing .book-card, .mw-landing .arc-phase { transition: none; }
              .mw-landing .btn-primary:hover, .mw-landing .btn-ghost:hover,
              .mw-landing .pillar:hover, .mw-landing .book-card:hover { transform: none; }
            }
          </style>

<section class="mw-hero">
  <p class="hero-eyebrow">Identity · Devices · Data · Certificates · DNS</p>
  <h1>Every migration is a <em>governance</em> migration.</h1>
  <p class="hero-sub">The Modernization Workbook is a set of topic books for moving a federal IT estate from Active Directory, Group Policy and on-premises infrastructure to cloud identity and governed hybrid operations. Each book opens with one question, answers it in four parts, and footnotes every external claim to a primary source.</p>
  <div class="hero-actions">

<section class="mw-section" id="approach">
  <div class="mw-inner">
    <p class="section-label">How Every Book Works</p>
    <h2 class="section-title">One question. Four parts. Every claim sourced.</h2>
    <p class="section-body">Each book takes one modernization topic and answers the same four questions in order. Every external fact is checked against a primary source (Microsoft Learn, NIST, OMB, CISA, FedRAMP, the IETF) and footnoted, the diagrams share one house style, and each book comes with a Word edition and a 15-minute presentation.</p>
    <div class="pillars">
      <div class="pillar">
        <div class="pillar-label">Why</div>
        <h3>Why the topic matters now.</h3>
        <p>The opening question each book answers, and the mandate, risk or loss that makes it urgent.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pillar what">
        <div class="pillar-label">What</div>
        <h3>What changes, and what replaces it.</h3>
        <p>What the old system quietly did, what the target architecture is, and the decisions that carry the risk.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pillar who">
        <div class="pillar-label">Who</div>
        <h3>Who decides, and who does the work.</h3>
        <p>Owners, approvers and operators, with the separation of duties the controls expect.</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pillar how">
        <div class="pillar-label">How</div>
        <h3>How to migrate, operate and evidence it.</h3>
        <p>Phased migration with rollback at every step, day-two operations, and the evidence an assessor will ask for.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="mw-section band" id="problem">
  <div class="mw-inner problem-grid">
    <div>
      <p class="section-label">The Problem</p>
      <h2 class="section-title">Active Directory did more governance than anyone wrote down.</h2>
    </div>
    <div>
      <p class="section-body">For twenty years the directory quietly decided who existed, what a computer received, which certificates were trusted and where names resolved. Moving to the cloud removes that machinery, and each piece fails in its own way, often long after the cutover is declared done. Each book takes one of those pieces.</p>
      <ul class="problem-list">
        <li><span>Identity lifecycle driven by IT tickets instead of the HR system of record. <a href="docs/books/b03-hr-identity/index.html">Book 03</a></span></li>
        <li><span>Access decisions scattered across groups, roles and exceptions with no single policy. <a href="docs/books/b04-access/index.html">Book 04</a></span></li>
        <li><span>Group Policy targeting by OU position, which nothing in Intune reads. <a href="docs/books/b05-devices/index.html">Book 05</a></span></li>
        <li><span>Windows Authentication and NTLM hidden inside the database estate. <a href="docs/books/b06-data-platform/index.html">Book 06</a></span></li>
        <li><span>Certificates that keep working after cutover, until the first expiry finds no issuer. <a href="docs/books/b07-pki/index.html">Book 07</a></span></li>
        <li><span>Split-brain DNS that surfaces as certificate errors and access denials. <a href="docs/books/b08-ddi/index.html">Book 08</a></span></li>
      </ul>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="mw-section" id="books">
  <div class="mw-inner">
    <p class="section-label">The Books</p>
    <h2 class="section-title">Seven books published. Eleven more on the way.</h2>
    <p class="section-body">Start with Book 02 for the directory migration as a whole, or go straight to the topic in front of you. Every book reads in its Why / What / Who / How order and downloads as one Word document.</p>

        <div class="book-q">Why does identity matter?</div>
        <div class="book-desc">Active Directory to Entra ID: the hidden migration surface, delegation without OUs, assessing the forest, and building the Entra ID target.</div>
        <div class="book-links"><a href="docs/books/b02-identity/index.html">Read</a><a href="downloads/b02-identity-bundle.docx">Word</a><a href="docs/presentations/index.html#book-02">Deck</a></div>

        <div class="book-q">Why should HR, not IT, decide who exists?</div>
        <div class="book-desc">Federal HR 2.0 and the Entra ID migration as one opportunity: the HR record as the source of identity.</div>
        <div class="book-links"><a href="docs/books/b03-hr-identity/index.html">Read</a><a href="downloads/b03-hr-identity-bundle.docx">Word</a><a href="docs/presentations/index.html#book-03">Deck</a></div>

        <div class="book-q">Why do certificates outlive every migration?</div>
        <div class="book-desc">AD CS to Cloud PKI, Entra certificate-based authentication and Federal PKI, and retiring the old CAs.</div>
        <div class="book-links"><a href="docs/books/b07-pki/index.html">Read</a><a href="downloads/b07-pki-bundle.docx">Word</a><a href="docs/presentations/index.html#book-07">Deck</a></div>
